days.title: Northern Peaks and Forests
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Volturino
stops.detail: Its perimeter stands out over a large part of the Lucanian Apennines, along an articulated border that extends from the peaks of the Volturino and Pierfaone mountains to the Sirino massif, which includes some of the highest peaks of the southern Apennines.

stops.name: abetina di Laurenzana
stops.detail: The residual fir forest of Laurenzana is worth highlighting.

days.title: The Agri Valley Basin
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: massiccio della Maddalena
stops.detail: Between these two complexes, imposing and jagged, the gentler peaks of the Maddalena massif open out like a fan, a mountain range with a gentle and lower profile that encloses the upper valley of the Agri river.

stops.name: fiume Agri
stops.detail: Among the various animals present, the wolf, the deer, the Italian roe deer, the wild boar and the otter along the Agri river should be noted in particular.
